about: Labeled replay set for the agent-loop router (ui_only vs needs_tools) on the /shop pet-food demo. Labels follow UI_ONLY_DESCRIPTION and NEEDS_TOOLS_DESCRIPTION in apps/demo/src/server/agent-session.ts (prototype branch ktrz/composed-planner-prototype @ febb09121b26f24c777cefe458b19b0fc349c6f8). recentConversation matches #recentText(): at most the last 4 plain user/assistant text messages before the latest request, each mapped to `${role}: ${content}`, with tool messages and [screen] notes dropped. Customer: Sam Rivera, dog Biscuit (adult Labrador), cat Miso (indoor adult). Cases marked borderline are honest judgment calls, scored separately.

cases.latestRequest: Reorder my dog's usual food, but something lower in fat this time, and check out.
cases.note: Live MAE-826 journey prompt. Several steps, past-order lookup, comparison, cart and checkout.

cases.latestRequest: Show my last order and also find cheaper alternatives.
cases.note: Live two-part prompt. Second half needs the order's products and a price comparison.

cases.latestRequest: Can you pull up my order history?
cases.note: Paraphrase of the 'show my past orders' example. One screen change.

cases.latestRequest: Open my last order.
cases.note: Paraphrase of the 'open my most recent order' example (showMostRecentOrder).

cases.latestRequest: What's in my cart right now?
cases.note: Showing the cart answers it. Matches the 'show the cart' example.

cases.latestRequest: Give the catalog more room, it's too cramped.
cases.note: Layout change, paraphrase of 'make the catalog bigger'.

cases.latestRequest: Get rid of the checkout panel for now.
cases.note: Paraphrase of the 'hide checkout' example.

recentConversation: user: Show me salmon wet food for my cat.
assistant: Here are the salmon wet foods for cats.
cases.latestRequest: Clear that and just show me everything you sell.
cases.note: clearSearch, one screen change. 'that' refers to the screen filter, not to a data result.

recentConversation: user: Open my most recent order.
assistant: Here's your most recent order, ORD-10482.
cases.latestRequest: Go back to the list of all my orders.
cases.note: Navigation back to the orders list view.

recentConversation: user: Find lower-fat dry food for Biscuit.
assistant: Here are lower-fat dry foods similar to Biscuit's usual Summit Trail Adult.
user: Open the Northpaw Lean one.
assistant: Here are the details for Northpaw Lean Adult, 10% fat.
cases.latestRequest: Close the details and go back to the results.
cases.note: Multi-turn. Navigation within the catalog, no data lookup.

cases.latestRequest: Hide my orders, I don't need them on screen.
cases.note: Layout change like 'hide checkout'.

recentConversation: user: Show my past orders.
assistant: Here are your past orders, newest first.
cases.latestRequest: Now show me the cart.
cases.note: Multi-turn. 'show the cart' example after an unrelated turn.

recentConversation: user: Place the order.
assistant: Your order ORD-10490 is placed. Total $64.98.
cases.latestRequest: Okay, dismiss the confirmation.
cases.note: Multi-turn. returnToCheckoutReview, one screen change.

cases.latestRequest: Make the cart smaller.
cases.note: Layout change, mirror of 'make the catalog bigger'.

cases.latestRequest: Show the food catalog.
cases.note: Bring one existing view on screen.

cases.latestRequest: Add two bags of Biscuit's usual kibble to my cart.
cases.note: Past-order lookup for the SKU, then adding to cart.

recentConversation: user: Show the cart.
assistant: Here's your cart: one bag of Summit Trail Healthy Weight, $64.98.
cases.latestRequest: Looks good, place the order.
cases.note: Placing an order is listed under needs_tools.

cases.latestRequest: Which is cheaper per kilo, Summit Trail Healthy Weight or Northpaw Lean?
cases.note: Comparison over product data.

cases.latestRequest: What would you recommend for Miso? She's an indoor cat and getting a bit chubby.
cases.note: Recommendation.

recentConversation: user: Find something like Biscuit's usual food but lower in fat.
assistant: Here are lower-fat options: Northpaw Lean Adult at 10% fat and Summit Trail Healthy Weight at 11%.
cases.latestRequest: Add the first one.
cases.note: Multi-turn. Reference to an earlier result plus adding to cart.

recentConversation: user: Add Summit Trail Healthy Weight to my cart.
assistant: Added one bag of Summit Trail Healthy Weight to your cart.
user: How does Northpaw Lean compare?
assistant: Northpaw Lean has 10% fat against 11%, and costs $3 less per bag.
cases.latestRequest: Swap it for that one then.
cases.note: Multi-turn. 'it' and 'that one' refer to earlier results, and the cart changes.

cases.latestRequest: How much did I spend on cat food over my last three orders?
cases.note: Lookup over several orders and arithmetic.

cases.latestRequest: Find a salmon wet food for Miso and put a case in the cart.
cases.note: Search then add to cart, several steps.

cases.latestRequest: Take the cat food out of my cart and check out.
cases.note: Cart change plus placing the order.

recentConversation: user: Open my most recent order.
assistant: Here's your most recent order, ORD-10482: Summit Trail Adult 30 lb and Whiskerly Indoor Salmon wet, 12 cans.
cases.latestRequest: Order it again.
cases.note: Multi-turn. 'it' refers to an earlier result, then cart and order.

cases.latestRequest: Is the dog food I bought last time grain-free?
cases.note: Look up the last order's product and reason over its description.

recentConversation: user: Show me dry dog food.
assistant: Here are the dry dog foods.
cases.latestRequest: Which of these is best for a Labrador that needs to lose weight?
cases.note: Multi-turn. Recommendation over the results already on screen.

cases.latestRequest: Take me to checkout.
cases.note: Navigation only, no order placed, so one screen change. But NEEDS_TOOLS_DESCRIPTION lists 'checkout', which can be read as this. In the MAE-826 trial the loop treated a similar phrase as a request to finish the purchase.

cases.latestRequest: Show me all the dog food.
cases.note: One catalog search with species=dog, which the UI can do itself. Arguably a data lookup, which the descriptions put under needs_tools.

cases.latestRequest: Show dry dog food with under 12% fat.
cases.note: One searchProducts call with species, foodType and maxFatPercent filters, a single screen change. The fat criterion reads like 'reasoning over data'.

cases.latestRequest: What did I order last time?
cases.note: showMostRecentOrder is documented as the quickest way to answer this, so opening the order is enough. Phrased as a question, so a model may want a spoken answer from data.

cases.latestRequest: Empty my cart.
cases.note: One cart action (clearCart), but it changes data like 'adding to cart' does, and the composed Planner hands side effects off. Neither description names it.

recentConversation: user: Show my past orders.
assistant: Here are your past orders, newest first.
cases.latestRequest: Open the one from March.
cases.note: Multi-turn. 'the one' refers to an earlier result and needs the order id looked up by date, but the result is a single screen change.
